proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal — Proxy Voting Record on Executive Compensation
proposals.proponent: The Stephen M. Silberstein Revocable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating options for BlackRock to bring its proxy voting on executive compensation in line with its stated principle of linking executive pay and performance.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote " AGAINST " the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: Production of an Annual Report on Certain Trade Association and Lobbying Expenditures
proposals.proponent: American Federation of Labor and Congress of Industrial Organizations (AFL-CIO)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing BlackRock's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, grassroots lobbying, and trade association and model-legislation payments with oversight details.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote " AGAINST " the shareholder proposal.
